location.en: Surface of asteroid 433 Eros (south of Himeros)

function.en: First spacecraft to orbit and land on an asteroid, measuring its shape, mass and the absence of a magnetic field.

mechanicalReuse.en: Serves as a mechanical calibration beacon and fixed navigation point for future mining missions on Eros.

location.en: Escaping the Solar System toward the star Aldebaran (~118.8 AU)

function.en: First crossing of the asteroid belt, Jupiter flyby and carrier of a commemorative plaque.

mechanicalReuse.en: Acts as a physical interstellar time capsule carrying the engraved aluminum plaque with data about Earth.

statusDetail.en: Retired in a safe heliocentric orbit.

function.en: Discovered more than 2,600 exoplanets using the transit method.

mechanicalReuse.en: Operational engineering reuse: during K2 it used the pressure of sunlight on its body as a 'rudder' to keep its pointing. In orbit, it is an inert target for deep-survey telescope detection tests.
